products.name: Glasshand
products.tagline_zh: Give your agent a real iPhone and Mac
products.description_zh: Glasshand gives your AI agents real iPhones and Macs to work on. Connect Claude Code, Codex, or any other agent, and it can rent a device with a single prompt. The hardware sits in our data center, and your agent uses it the way you would: posting on TikTok, booking an Uber, or building and testing iOS apps. Each device is yours alone for as long as you rent it. When you’re done, we erase your data and factory-reset it.

products.name: Living Brain
products.tagline_zh: Interoperable, efficient memory layer for agentic AI
products.description_zh: Every AI conversation contains knowledge worth keeping, but most of it gets trapped in separate chats and tools. Living Brain captures that knowledge, connects it to what you already know, and turns it into a persistent memory that keeps evolving. Share that intelligence across AI models, apps, and agents through API, SDK, or MCP, so every new interaction builds on the last instead of starting over. Reuse memory across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, OpenClaw, Hermes, Cursor, Codex and more

products.name: Maritime
products.tagline_zh: Cloud computers for any AI agent, customized your way
products.description_zh: Maritime gives AI agents their own cloud computers: persistent workspaces, disposable sandboxes, Linux and Windows desktops, and Android phones. Agents can run code, use browsers, and work in apps without APIs, with a human able to take over when needed. Whether you’re building a personal assistant or running thousands of tasks in parallel, Maritime handles the computers so you can focus on what your agent does.

products.name: Pushary for Teams
products.tagline_zh: See who said yes to your team’s AI agents
products.description_zh: When an AI agent stops to ask permission, Pushary sends the question to the person running it, in their Mac’s notch or on their phone. Lee’s agent asks Lee. Sam’s agent asks Sam. A rule can send a push to your infra repo to your lead instead. Answers from the phone, Mac app and dashboard are saved with a name, so when something breaks, one page shows whose agent asked and who said yes. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Agy and Hermes.
